data.name: E-Bike Tour – Honolulu Rainforest Ride
data.headline: Ages 14+ • Appx. 3 hour tour
data.description:
#“10-Miles of Smiles”.. Yes, E-bike tours are here in Honolulu, Hawaii.

Introducing our latest innovation: the solar-powered electric-assist bicycle tour. Featuring an 11-speed drivetrain, 250-watt motor, and 500-watt battery, our e-bikes offer a powerful boost for climbing while maintaining the exhilarating feel of riding a mountain bike. Ascend above Honolulu on our 10MilesofSmiles ride, a paved mountain road adventure perfect for couples.
data.highlights:
- Climbing over 1,600 feet above Honolulu, you’ll be treated to breathtaking vistas stretching from Manoa Valley to Diamond Head, and from Waikiki to Ewa Beach and Pearl Harbor, with the majestic Waianae Mountains on the horizon. Along the way, we make stops at the finest viewpoints, allowing you to capture the memories of this lush rainforest journey.
As you pedal through changing landscapes of eucalyptus forest, swamp mahogany, bamboo, and banyan, you may find yourself riding through the clouds and mist, serenaded by the songs of various birds. It’s a true nature biking experience, offering a glimpse into the untamed beauty of Oahu’s rainforest.
